info.name: Demo NEAPS v2 with CLI YAML command
info.description:
The purpose of this collection is to demo the use of the NEAPS REST APIs for the management of a custom NE audit capability using the **CLI YAML** NE protocol.

Note that this **CLI YAML** is used by the RLS NEs, where all CLI responses are based on the YAML data format.

**CLI classic** is the other NEAPS supported type of CLI that covers all the CLI with similar data format where the responses are based on text/tabulated tables as found from all SAOS and CienaWaveserver NEs. There is a dedicated **CLI classic** postman collection.

The NEAPS management process flow covers all of the NEAPS REST APIs. It has been developed using the **License** for NE configuration supported by all **RLS** NEs. Note that a default NEAPS is available by the Navigator MC audit application for this same License-RLS NE audit capability.

For details about NEAPS check this Ciena internal page: [NEAPS On-line Help](https://confluence.ciena.com/pages/viewpage.action?spaceKey=MCPRD&title=MCPA+NEAPS+On-line+Help)

The collection is stored in Ciena bitbucket [mcp-docs](https://bitbucket.ciena.com/projects/BP_MCP_SERVICES/repos/mcp-docs/browse/modules/api-guide/assets/attachments) repository.

# Preliminary Setup

Set the Variables used by this collection

- NMC_SERVER - the HTTP address of the Navigator MC server
- NE_NAME - the name of the RLS NE with a golden License config
    
- NE_FUNCTION - the NE audit capability label demonstrated by this collection
